winCondition: Episodes have two acts (before and after summoning the Elder One). If any investigator dies before the summoning the team loses; after the Elder One is on the board the team can still win while at least one investigator lives.

endCondition.description: Lose if an investigator dies before the summoning; after that, win needs at least one survivor.

notes: family: coop. No points. Details of how the Elder One is defeated vary per episode/Elder box and were not verified from the rulebook (downloads blocked). Check the official rulebook before upgrading confidence.
